newsitem.title: USA: U.S Stockpile sells manganese ore samples.
newsitem.headline: U.S Stockpile sells manganese ore samples.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 205 short dry tons of metallurgical grade manganese ore for a total of approximately $700.
Stockpile said 180 tons went to American Minerals and 25 tons went to Cameron Chemical.
Stockpile also sold 198 short dry tons of natural battery grade manganese ore for approximately $10,000 to Prince Manufacturing.
All the awards were for sample quantities at lower than normal market prices, Stockpile said. No offers were received for chemical grade manganese ore.
The next date for receiving offers for manganese ore is August 5.
